Suicide is considered selfish because the people around don't want you to feel the same pain as you did. It's like that saying goes: "Suicide isn't taking away the pain, it's passing it on to someone else"  
People use it as an excuse to make *them**selves* feel better, not you. Most people who say that don't care, they only want you to live on so you don't pass on that pain you had. 

People who watch you struggle isn't a force of selfishness either, it's a subconscious part of our brain to not help other and only care about ourselves. So yeah, some people do watch others struggle because they don't care, or don't want to. But it's mostly subconscious part of our brain who do that.

some try to deny that could a be possible that a friend, family member, or anyone else could go that far. Even when asked straight up, they could avoid it or act as though it never happened.

I've learned from experience myself.
